scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,blue "npm run dev -w @pum/api" "npm run dev -w @pum/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @pum/shared && npm run build -w @pum/api && npm run build -w @pum/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @pum/shared && npm run typecheck -w @pum/api && npm run typecheck -w @pum/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @pum/shared && npm run test -w @pum/api
